description: Typed optional publication intent for existing media upload request options; mirrored from Engine UploadOptions/UploadPurpose. Request envelopes remain compatible JSON objects.

enums.name: MediaUploadPurpose
enums.description: general remains private; avatar explicitly publishes a validated image under the dedicated anonymous-read prefix.

models.name: MediaUploadOptions
models.description: Optional upload options. Omitted chunkSize defaults to 256 KiB; omitted purpose defaults to general. options may contain purpose alone. No arbitrary Public access flag exists.

fields.name: chunkSize
fields.description: Optional positive part size, in bytes; absent preserves the existing default.

fields.name: purpose
fields.description: Explicit avatar publication intent. General uploads stay private. Avatar returns stable unsigned url/cdnUrl after real image validation.
